title: Contract Manager
description:
**General Description:**




 ·       Overall responsibility for managing all the commercial and financial activities (procurement, cost, budgets, contracts, claims, managing agreements with key partners) for the programme portfolio of projects under Projects Affairs and the Departments.
 



  





**Job Responsibilities:**




 ·       Maximise commercial performance while managing project risk (pre\-contract and post\- contract).
 



 ·       Handle procurement development and execution of diverse contractual actions using sound judgement to achieve optimal commercial outcomes in a timely manner to meet the operational needs of Projects Affairs and the Departments.
 



 ·       Ensure compliance with relevant commercial/contracting policies and the achievement of commercial targets.
 



 ·       Resolution of disputes and claims issues for all programme portfolio of projects under Projects Affairs and the Departments.
 



 ·       Embedding effective commercial governance and assurance across the programme portfolio of projects under Projects Affairs and the Departments.
 



 ·       Support the tender governance process for Projects Affairs and the Departments.
 



 ·       Lead complex contract negotiations (strategy and execution) including Procurement, Administration or Liquidation.
 



 ·       To make impartial priority calls and determine appropriate course of action and dealing with many different stakeholder views.
 



 ·       To think creatively and exercise sound judgement based on analysis of risk.
 



 ·       Identify innovative new solutions or ways of working and apply sound judgement to achieve the same end goal.
 



 ·       Build good working relationships within complex organisational structures, both internally and with various project stakeholders.
 



 ·       Developing team members with in\-depth commercial and cross\-functional expertise to support the programme portfolio of projects under Projects Affairs and the Departments.
 



 ·       Lead a team and promote collaboration to secure successful deliverables.
 



 ·       Ensure and review contract management and administration compliance related to programme portfolio of projects under Projects Affairs.
 



 ·       Ensure and review Programme and Project related financial management related issues are dealt with in a timely manner.
 



 ·       Initiate and conduct meetings as required with Supply Chain in relation to programme portfolio of projects under Projects Affairs related commercial and contract management matters.
 



 ·       Manage the delivery, when required, of variations, addendums, extensions of time, claims etc; ensuring that they are being processed in accordance with the Authority’s relevant policies and procedures.
 



 ·       Being initiative and proactive to locate shortcomings or potential problems in the administrative procedures or contract terms and conditions and recommend solutions.
 



 ·       Review, prepare and lead procurement actions and commercial contract negotiations using data\-driven approaches.
 



 ·       Familiar with financial information and is aware of financial impacts on bids/contracts/projects.
 



 ·       Provide support to the Projects Affairs’ Departments where required, on commercial matters.
 



 ·       Escalate issues within the Authority as and when required.
 



 ·       Performs other duties and responsibilities associated with this position as may be appropriate.
 



 ·       Develops procedures and guidelines for commercial and contractual matters.
 



  





**Mandatory Requirements:**




 ·       University degree in a relevant field such as Civil Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Commercial Management, Construction Management, or equivalent obtained from universities identified in the World Higher Education Database (WHED) published by the International Association of Universities.
 



 ·       Chartered status or Professional Licensed from internationally recognized professional institutions or organizations in the field of Quantity Surveying.
 



 ·       More than 20 years of practical and relevant experience since obtaining the educational qualifications specified, including 7 years at a senior level with the commercial and contract management of large\-scale infrastructure and building programmes.
 



 ·       Minimum of 10 years of experience working in North America, W. Europe, UK, Australia, New Zealand or equivalent developed country or 10 years of experience of working in Qatar.
 



 ·       7 years’ experience of working within PMO or Commercial Department of government organisations within the GCC.
 



 ·       Minimum 10 years of experience with roles similar to proposed role.
 



 ·       Excellent communication skills in English, written and spoken..
 



 Chartered, Licensed or Professional Certification is a requirement from internationally recognized professional institutions or organizations in the Legal or Dispute Resolution fields (i.e., MCIArb).
 



 Grade A QS certified by the Qatar Ministry of Municipality (MMUP/UPDA).
 



  





**Desirable requirements**




 ·       Master’s degree in a relevant field.
 



 ·       Preferably having working experience in Qatar and/or the Gulf region and have worked on the Client side.
